comparison.objective: Unmold a tart by supporting it on a stand and lowering the loose pan ring.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual support and controlled coaxial separation around a fragile object.
comparison.success_condition: Tart is released onto the stand without stated damage; detailed scoring thresholds are absent.
comparison.reason: Coaxial unmolding and fragile support do not test tool use, retained fine adjustment, locking torque, or dynamic response.
